header.name: Muhammad Ahmed
header.tagline: Building games, XR worlds and data-driven tools.

cards.title: Crew Biography
cards.text: Muhammad Ahmed is a BS Computer Science & IT student at NED University (2023-2027, CGPA 3.515), passionate about making games and working with data. He builds games and XR experiences in Unity and C#, a React Native health app, and a flood-simulation final year project.
details: University: NED University of Engineering and Technology

cards.title: Mission Focus
cards.text: Muhammad focuses on game development in Unity and C#, and is currently moving deeper into data science. He completed the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate.

cards.title: Off-Duty Hobbies
cards.text: Coding is his favorite way to spend free time.

cards.title: Home Base
cards.text: Karachi, Pakistan. Open to internship opportunities.
